Community Listening Tour with Angela Reason
events.description:
Event date: October 20, 2026 
Event Time: 05:30 PM - 07:00 PM
Location: 
Behind City Hall
2400 Washington Ave
Newport News, VA 23607
Description:
Angela F. Reason, Clerk of the Newport News Circuit Court, in partnership with the Virginia Access to Justice Commission, will host a Community Listening Tour. The event gives Newport News residents the opportunity to share their experiences and ideas about access to justice directly with members of the Virginia Access to Justice Commission, Newport News judges, and members of the local legal community. Community organizations will also host resource tables to connect attendees with services and support.

events.name: A Scientist Walks Into A Bar
events.description:
Event date: October 16, 2026 
Event Time: 06:00 PM - 07:30 PM
Location: 
Newport News, VA 23607
Description:
 What happens when you mix science, water, and your favorite local watering hole? You get A Scientist Walks Into a Bar… from Newport News Waterworks! Join us for a fun, free conversation about the science behind the water in your glass. We’ll explore the fascinating connection between water, water treatment, and the beverages we enjoy, with a few surprising facts along the way. You’ll learn more about where our water comes from, how Newport News Waterworks treats it, and why high-quality water matters to the brewing, distilling, and beverage-making process. And because no good bar conversation is complete without a little friendly competition, we’ll wrap things up with water-themed trivia and a chance to win some Waterworks swag!

benefits.name: Homeownership Assistance Program
benefits.description: First-time buyers in Newport News may be eligible for up to $5,000 in down payment and closing cost assistance. This program aims to make homeownership more accessible for local residents by providing financial support for those who qualify based on income and residency requirements.

benefits.name: Virginia Senior Tax Relief Program
benefits.description: Property tax exemptions are available for seniors (65+) and individuals with disabilities meeting certain criteria. This state-mandated program provides significant savings for eligible homeowners in Newport News, helping them remain in their homes comfortably.

benefits.name: Cape Henry Memorial
benefits.description: Commemorates the site where English colonists first landed in 1607 and a key location during the Revolutionary War naval battle.

benefits.name: Free Community Wi-Fi Expansion
benefits.description: Newport News has successfully expanded its free community Wi-Fi spots across the downtown area and major city parks. This initiative provides high-speed internet access to help students, remote workers, and families stay connected. Look for the 'NN-Free-Wifi' network in participating public spaces.
